g.title: cluster_web
g.text: Presentation tier: BrokerVerse SPA (React 18, PrimeReact, Redux Toolkit)

g.title: cluster_api
g.text: Application tier: BrokerVerse API (Node.js 22, Express 4), stateless

g.title: user
g.text: Broker staff (browser): Sales & Marketing, Processing Team, Operations, Claims,
Accounting, Accounting Manager, Compliance Officer, System Administrator

g.title: pipeline
g.text: HTTP pipeline: request id, helmet, CORS, pino-http log, rate limit,
JSON limit, signed file links, error envelope

g.title: spa_core
g.text: Shared front-end services: API client and token refresh, route guard,
runtime theme engine, help panel (F1), i18n, dialogs and toasts

g.title: spa_adm
g.text: users and access, theme and branding,

g.title: modules
g.text: sales, distribution and policy, placement and co-insurance, claims, renewals,
billing, receipts and payables, remittance, commission, posting rules,
period end, BIR returns and invoices, reconciliation, reinsurance,
AML/CFT and privacy, My Work, go-live workbench, administration

g.title: ext
g.text: SMS and Viber gateways, CTPL / LTO,
